'''Korq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Korq was hired by [[Squeerie]], a [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] salvage operator. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], they attempted to salvage the remains of a wrecked [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], in the [[Almas Wasteland]], on [[Almas]]. However, they were attacked by [[Tantron Dow]], a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], who had fallen under the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].
